scenes.title: Something in the road
script: narrate:A wolf is standing in the middle of the road. All ribs, its coat matted with salt and burrs, its eyes a flat, sick yellow.
narrate:It's on you before you can move. Teeth sink into your forearm, and the ground comes up hard.
narrate:An arrow hisses past your ear. Then another. The wolf yelps, lets go, and doesn't get up.
say:Ida:"You're the one Yenson pulled out of the sea? Ida. I keep the hunters' lodge in Skelmed."
say:Ida:She takes your arm and turns it to the light. "Third one this month with eyes like that."
say:Ida:"That bite wants cleaning before it turns. Get yourself into Skelmed and find Bess at the gate. Tell her I sent you."

scenes.title: Something in the road
text: A wolf is standing in the middle of the road. It's all ribs, its grey coat matted with salt and burrs. Wolves don't come this close to the sea. It isn't growling. It's just watching you.
Its eyes are the wrong colour: a flat, sick yellow, like old pus. It doesn't blink.

scenes.title: It comes for you
text: Your foot slips on a stone. The wolf sees it and comes for you, silent and fast.

scenes.title: Still
text: The wolf lies still in the road. As you watch, the yellow drains out of its eyes and leaves them an ordinary amber.
Whatever was in it is gone. It was just a hungry animal, once.
Only now do you feel it: your forearm is torn and bleeding where it got its teeth into you. Animal bites go bad. You'll need to clean it and bind it, and soon.

scenes.title: Away
text: It gets its teeth into your calf as you turn, and you tear free and run. You don't look back until your lungs give out. When you do, the road behind you is empty, and your leg is bleeding into your boot.

scenes.title: A little kindness
text: The wolf snaps the bread out of the air and swallows it whole. For a moment, the yellow in its eyes seems to flicker, and it looks like nothing more than a starving animal.
Then it turns and slinks off into the gorse.

scenes.title: Slowly
text: You back away one step at a time, never taking your eyes off it. The wolf watches you go, then loses interest and lopes off into the gorse.

choices.label: Walk on, the long way round

scenes.title: Supper
text: The crab stops moving. The yellow crust on its eyes cracks and flakes away.

choices.label: Crack it open for the meat
choices.result: Two good handfuls of crab meat. Your knife has never been put to better use.

scenes.title: A fisherman
text: A wiry man with a coil of rope over one shoulder stops, surprised to see anyone at all on the road.

choices.label: Ask him about Skelmed
choices.result: "Skelmed? Ask for Ida at the hunters' lodge. She'll find a use for you, if you've a strong back. Tell her Tam sent you."

scenes.speaker: Tam

scenes.title: Dead gulls
text: There are dead gulls in the gorse beside the road. Six or seven of them, lying in a ring. Their eyes have gone the same flat, sick yellow as the wolf's, and the gorse around them has turned black.
The hair stands up on your arms. Something here is wrong, deeper than dead birds.

choices.label: Burn them with your flint
choices.result: The gorse catches easily. You stand back and watch until there's nothing left but ash. The wrongness goes with the smoke.

choices.label: Burn them with Kindle
choices.result: Fire leaps from your hand into the black gorse. When it's done, the air feels clean again.

choices.label: Leave them
choices.result: You walk on. The feeling follows you a long way.

scenes.title: The tide pools
text: Black rocks run out into the sea here, pocked with pools. Weed hangs off everything.

choices.label: Search the tide pools
choices.result: You pick your way out over the weed-slick rocks. Most of the pools are empty, but you prise two handfuls of mussels off the stones before a wave soaks you to the knee.

choices.label: Poke about for anything else
choices.result: A few more mussels. The pools have been picked over now, mostly by you.

scenes.title: The cairn
text: A heap of stones on the highest point of the headland, piled by hand long ago. From here the whole coast lies open.

choices.label: Climb up on the cairn for a look around
Look out over the land again

scenes.title: The lie of the land
text: From the top of the headland you can see Loran laid out to the east: green fields, a dark line of forest to the south, and the glint of a river cutting across the north of the country.
Far off, at the very edge of sight, the sky over the land looks wrong. A faint yellow tint, like a bruise that's started to turn.
You can't say why, but you don't like looking at it.

scenes.title: The stream
text: Cold, clear water.

choices.label: Drink and fill your waterskin
choices.result: The water is cold enough to hurt your teeth. You drink, then fill the skin.

scenes.title: Brambles
text: Bramble bushes crowd the bank, heavy with fruit.

choices.label: Pick blackberries
choices.result: Your hands come away scratched and stained purple, with three good handfuls of blackberries.

choices.label: Pick what's left
choices.result: A handful of the last berries, mostly the small sour ones.

scenes.title: Deadwood
text: A fallen branch, grey and dry.

choices.label: Gather it
choices.result: You snap it into lengths and bundle it under your arm.

scenes.title: The wreck
text: What's left of the trade boat lies on its side in the sand, ribs showing through the planking like a carcass. The tide has been through it, and the gulls after the tide.
You were on this. You don't remember much more than the noise.

extra.text: You've had everything out of the hull that's worth having.

choices.label: Climb inside and search
choices.result: It stinks of wet rope and tar. Wedged under a fallen beam you find the cook's locker: a stoppered flask of something strong and a roll of linen, still dry in its oilcloth.

scenes.title: A crate
text: A crate from the hold, split along one side, its planks stamped with the merchant's mark. Most of what was in it is pulp.

choices.label: Search it
choices.result: Two loaves in an oilcloth wrap, damp at the edges but good, and a tinderbox with the flint and steel still dry inside. You'll want that, out there.

scenes.title: A sea chest
text: A sailor's sea chest, half sunk in the sand, its iron bands already rusting. The lid's been sprung by the sea.

choices.label: Open it
choices.result: Somebody's whole life in a box: a spare shirt, ruined, a carved bone comb, a letter too wet to read. And a knife in a sheath, and a purse with thirty coppers in it. Whoever they were, they won't need these now.

scenes.title: A barrel
text: A barrel has rolled up the beach and stove itself in on a rock. It smells of brine.

choices.label: See what's left
choices.result: Salt fish, packed in brine. Most of it is spoiled, but two are good. They'll keep.
